model.name: Forbidden endpoint pairing regression fixture
model.documentation: Regression fixture: a Composition relationship whose whole is an active structure element (BusinessActor) and whose part is a behavioral element (BusinessService). Passes structural schema validation; must fail semantic validation with rule SEMANTIC_ILLEGAL_ENDPOINT_PAIR.

relationship.name: contains
relationship.documentation: Illegal pairing: active structure cannot be the whole of a behavioral part.
